pre.code: [MarineTraffic + Lloyd's List] [Oil price / market data] | | +----------------+---------------+ | [Signal Agent] <- Agent 1: Watcher | [Intelligence Agent] <- Agent 2: Interpreter | [Forecast Agent] <- Agent 3: ARIMA + XGBoost | [Simulation Agent] <- Agent 4: Strategist (3 scenarios) | [Decision Agent] <- Agent 5: Brain (ranked actions) | [Alert Agent] <- Agent 6: Communicator | [Execution Agent] <- Agent 7: Operator (ERP workflows) | [FastAPI + SSE] | [Dashboard UI]

aegis_df2/ ├── agents/ │ └── swarm.py # 7-agent pipeline logic + parameterized 4-source │ # marine scraper with Pydantic-validated schemas ├── api/ │ └── server.py # FastAPI app: /health, /ready, /api/marine, │ # /api/crisis, /api/stream (SSE), /api/status — │ # typed responses, JSON logs, optional Sentry ├── models/ │ └── forecaster.py # ARIMA(2,1,2) + XGBoost hybrid, validated output schema ├── experiments/ │ ├── config.yaml # Config-driven experiment parameters │ ├── run_baseline_comparison.py # Ablation with per-day error + crisis scenarios │ ├── results.json # Latest run's output (reproducible via config.yaml) │ └── README.md # Findings write-up ├── tests/ │ ├── test_forecaster.py # Horizon, bounds, crisis-shock, schema, blend isolation │ ├── test_server.py # Health (credential-free smoke test), ready, endpoints │ ├── test_swarm.py # Scraper consolidation + schema validation │ └── test_experiments.py# Reproducibility + per-day error tests ├── .devcontainer/ │ └── devcontainer.json # One-click VS Code / Codespaces environment ├── .github/ │ ├── workflows/ci.yml # Lint + test (60% cov gate) + pip-audit — manual trigger │ └── dependabot.yml # Weekly pip + GitHub Actions update PRs ├── Dockerfile # All-in-one image (locked deps, HEALTHCHECK) ├── .dockerignore ├── docker-compose.yml # One-command local stack ├── frontend.html # Dashboard UI ├── requirements.txt # 16 direct runtime deps, exact pins (bump versions here) ├── requirements-dev.txt # pytest, pytest-cov, ruff, pip-audit, PyYAML ├── requirements-lock.txt # pip-compile hashed full closure (runtime + dev) ├── pyproject.toml # pytest + coverage configuration ├── ruff.toml ├── .env.example # GROQ_API_KEY, LOG_LEVEL, SENTRY_DSN ├── CHANGELOG.md ├── CONTRIBUTING.md └── README.md
pip install -r requirements-lock.txt -r requirements-dev.txt pytest -q --cov --cov-report=term-missing ruff check . pip-audit -r requirements-lock.txt

div.div: Business case (from the original hackathon pitch)

pre.code: cp .env.example .env # then fill in GROQ_API_KEY pip install -r requirements-lock.txt # reproducible, hashed pins uvicorn api.server:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload
docker compose up --build # or standalone: docker build -t aegis . docker run -p 8000:8000 --env-file .env aegis
